curability.definition: n. capability of being cured or healed
curability.translation: n. 治愈可能性, 有痊愈希望

curable.definition:
a. curing or healing is possible
s. capable of being hardened by some additive or other agent
curable.translation:
a. 可医治的, 医得好的
[医] 可愈的, 能治愈的

curableness.definition: n. capability of being cured or healed

curacao.definition:
n a popular island resort in the Netherlands Antilles
n flavored with sour orange peel
curacao.translation: n. 柑桂酒, 柑香酒

curacies.translation: n. 副牧师的职务；助理牧师的身份

curacoa.definition:
n. A liqueur, or cordial, flavored with orange peel,
   cinnamon, and mace; -- first made at the island of Curaccao.
curacoa.translation: n. 柑桂酒, 柑香酒

curacy.definition: n. the position of a curate

curameter.translation: 硫化计, 硫化程度测定计

curandero.translation: [网络] 巫医；民间医生；医治者

curangin.translation: 枯苒苷, 苦蓝加苦苷

curare.definition: n a toxic alkaloid found in certain tropical South American trees that is a powerful relaxant for striated muscles
curare.translation:
n. 箭毒, 马钱子, 马钱子属植物, 番木鳖
[化] 箭毒; 苦拉拉

curari.definition:
n. A black resinoid extract prepared by the South American
   Indians from the bark of several species of Strychnos (S. toxifera,
   etc.). It sometimes has little effect when taken internally, but is
   quickly fatal when introduced into the blood, and used by the Indians
   as an arrow poison.
curari.translation: n. 箭毒, 马钱子, 马钱子属植物, 番木鳖

curarine.definition:
n. A deadly alkaloid extracted from the curare poison and
   from the Strychnos toxifera. It is obtained in crystalline colorless
   salts.
curarine.translation:
n. 箭毒碱
[化] 箭毒碱

curarization.translation: [医] 箭毒化(使用箭毒,直至产生其生理作用)

curarize.definition: v. t. To poison with curare.
curarize.translation:
vt. 使中箭毒, 用箭毒于
[医] 用箭毒处理

curassow.definition: n. large crested arboreal game bird of warm parts of the Americas having long legs and tails; highly esteemed as game and food

curat.translation: abbr. curative 医疗的, 药品

curated.definition:
past participle of curate
n. a person authorized to conduct religious worship
curated.translation: (curate 的过去分词) n. 助理牧师

curates.definition: n. a person authorized to conduct religious worship
curates.translation:
n. 副牧师, 助理牧师( curate的复数形式 )
v. 副牧师, 助理牧师( curate的第三人称单数 )

curateship.translation: n. 助理牧师；副牧师 (curate的变形)

curating.definition:
-ing form of curate
n. a person authorized to conduct religious worship
curating.translation: (curate 的现在分词) n. 助理牧师

curation.translation: n. 治愈, 治疗; [IT]（对数字信息的）综合处理, 指对数字信息的选择, 保存, 管理等一系列处理行为, 其目的是建立完善的查询机制和提供可靠的参考数据; 策展

curative.definition: s. tending to cure or restore to health
curative.translation:
a. 治病的, 有疗效的
n. 药物, 治疗法

curator.definition: n. the custodian of a collection (as a museum or library)
curator.translation:
n. 管理者, 经理, 主管人, 掌管者, 馆长, 大学学监, 监护人, 保护人
[经] 临时监护人

curator furiosi.translation: [法] 精神病患者的保佐人

curator minorum.translation: [法] 适婚而未成年人的保佐人

curatorial.definition: a. of or relating to a curator or the duties of a curator

curators.definition: n. the custodian of a collection (as a museum or library)
curators.translation: n. 管理者( curator的复数形式 ); 管理人; 图书馆馆长; 管理者的职位（或身份）

curatorship.translation:
n. 管理者的职位, 评议员的地位
[法] 保佐, 临时监护, 馆长的职位

curatorships.definition:
plural of curatorship
n. the position of curator
curatorships.translation:
(curatorship 的复数) n. 管理者的职位, 评议员的地位
[法] 保佐, 临时监护, 馆长的职位

curatrix.definition:
n. A woman who cures.
n. A woman who is a guardian or custodian.
curatrix.translation: n. 女管理人或女监护人的团体
